statement: An independent physically read reference for DS4 USB feature 0x02 calibration, including its per-device bytes and CRC/revision rules, is not available in this corpus. Linux source expects 37 bytes and extracts gyro/accel bias/scale data.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 346–352, 1938–2116; historical hid-sony.c 1704–1788. Community PS4 wiki source pending for independent device-side corroboration.
